key_insight: A non-planar 3×3 Josephson crossbar qubit realizes flux-tunable \u03a6Z3 combinatorial gauge symmetry, offering a new route to lattice gauge physics in circuit QED.
engineering_relevance: This architecture expands qubit design beyond planar layouts, potentially enabling programmable quantum simulators for spin-liquid and gauge-theory models.
method: Built a non-planar 3×3 crossbar Josephson array inside a superconducting cavity
Tuned magnetic flux to access and probe the \u03a6Z3 gauge-symmetric point
Compared measured excitation spectra with a neural-network-generated variational quantum state model
evidence_signal: The observed excitation spectrum matches neural-network predictions closely, and cavity-driven symmetry breaking/restoration is consistent with the inferred \u03a6Z3 symmetry point.
watch_item: Fine-structure splittings near the symmetry point suggest weak tunneling or device imperfections may still break the ideal \u03a6Z3 degeneracy.
paper_title: Nonplanar qubit with tunable gauge symmetry
